mapper.select: /*getAuthGroupList*/ SELECT A.AUTH_CODE , A.AUTH_NAME , A.USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, A.USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}) AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , A.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(A.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , A.REGI_DATE , A.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(A.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , A.UPDT_DATE FROM TM_AUTHXM A ORDER BY A.AUTH_CODE

/*getAuthGroup*/ SELECT A.AUTH_CODE , A.AUTH_NAME , A.USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, A.USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}) AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , A.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(A.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , A.REGI_DATE , A.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(A.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , A.UPDT_DATE FROM TM_AUTHXM A WHERE A.AUTH_CODE = #{authCode}

/*getAuthMenuList*/ SELECT #{authCode} AS AUTH_CODE , M.MENU_NUMB , M.SUBX_NUMB , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_URLX , M.SORT_ORDR , NVL(A.READ_YSNO, #{no}) AS READ_YSNO , NVL(A.WRIT_YSNO, #{no}) AS WRIT_YSNO , NVL(A.DELT_YSNO, #{no}) AS DELT_YSNO FROM TM_ADMENU M LEFT JOIN TB_AUTHMN A ON A.AUTH_CODE = #{authCode} AND A.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND A.SUBX_NUMB = M.SUBX_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_ADMENU P ON P.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND P.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} WHERE NVL(M.USEE_YSNO, #{yes}) = #{yes} ORDER BY NVL(P.SORT_ORDR, M.SORT_ORDR) , TO_NUMBER(M.MENU_NUMB) , CASE WHEN M.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , NVL(M.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , TO_NUMBER(M.SUBX_NUMB)
